content.title: MOTIVE v2 Benchmark Prediction Rankings (36 configurations)
content.description_html: Browse top-50 gene-compound rankings exported from 36 retained ORF benchmark configurations. Each row is specific to its model_run_id and evaluation_split_strategy. model_ranking_score is a configuration-specific ranking score, not a calibrated interaction probability; compare candidates only within the same query and model run, and do not compare scores across configurations. is_connection_in_benchmark_annotations reports only whether the pair occurs in any benchmark message-passing, training, validation, or test subset; it is not biological validation. These unvalidated benchmark rankings cover only the scored ORF and compound candidates and contain no CRISPR predictions. See the exact Zenodo record and the scientific provenance and limitations.

columns.gene_perturbation_type: Gene perturbation modality. The observed value is orf_overexpression.
columns.evaluation_split_strategy: Benchmark split strategy: connections_randomly_held_out_from_training, compounds_held_out_from_training, or genes_held_out_from_training.
columns.graph_configuration: Graph edges used by the run: compound_gene_edges_only or compound_gene_edges_plus_compound_and_gene_similarity_edges.
columns.model_architecture: Scoring architecture used by the run: bilinear_scoring_model, graph_isomorphism_network, graphsage, or multilayer_perceptron.
columns.node_representation_strategy: Node inputs used by the run: cell_painting_profile_features or learned_node_embeddings.
columns.model_run_id: Six-character identifier for one of the 36 retained benchmark configurations. Use it with the other model-context fields when grouping comparisons.
columns.query_entity_type: Whether the row is grouped under a gene or compound query.
columns.query_entity_identifier: Query identifier: gene symbol for gene queries or 14-character InChIKey connectivity block for compound queries.
columns.candidate_entity_type: Candidate type, which is opposite the query entity type.
columns.candidate_entity_identifier: Candidate identifier: gene symbol or 14-character InChIKey connectivity block according to candidate type.
columns.gene_symbol: Gene member of the gene-compound pair, independent of query direction.
columns.compound_inchikey14: 14-character InChIKey connectivity block for the compound member of the pair, independent of query direction.
columns.model_ranking_score: Run-specific score used to rank candidates. It is not a calibrated interaction probability and is not directly comparable across configurations; compare candidates only within the same query and model run.
columns.candidate_rank_within_query: One-based rank from 1 through 50 within the query and model run. This is the preferred field for within-run candidate comparison.
columns.number_of_candidates_scored_for_query: Total candidates scored before retaining the top 50 for that query and model run.
columns.number_of_candidates_tied_at_score_withi: Number of candidates sharing the exact score within the query and model run before deterministic rank ordering.
columns.is_connection_in_benchmark_annotations: True only when the pair occurs in any benchmark message-passing, training, validation, or test subset. This uses a different reference set from the full-profile annotation flag and is not biological validation.
